story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Inbound 834 identifies required date sources and uses Eligibility Date for new enrollment before eligibility begins
gaps: Status field is "Edge" for id "TC_TS_001_003", but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example expected results include "The transmission completed successfully, allowing date selection logic to be verified in Facets." and "A Facets eligibility row exists with effective date 2025-01-31 for the submitted new enrollment."

scenarios.title: Current eligibility change uses Assessment Date when Assessment Date changes
gaps: Status field for id "TC_TS002_003" is "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Examples quoted: "The file is picked up by Edifecs within the normal polling interval.", "The correct AR PASSE transmission is returned and the file can be opened.", "No new FACETS eligibility or processed eligibility row is returned that demonstrates a newly created changed-Assessment-Date-driven transaction effective date for this submission."

scenarios.title: Assessment Date change with no relevant field changes updates only transaction effective date and preserves relevant fields
gaps: Status field "Edge" for id "TC_TS003_003" has no step whose Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record.

scenarios.title: Relevant field change before eligibility start uses Eligibility Date when Assessment Date is unchanged
gaps: Status field for id "TC_TS004_003" is "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example Expected Result text: "The transmission shows a successful disposition and accepted validation status with no policy unit failure for the boundary-condition file."

scenarios.title: Relevant field change after eligibility start uses Maintenance Date only when Assessment Date is unchanged
gaps: Status field is "Edge" for id "TC_TS005_003", but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example Expected Result text: "FACETS does not create an additional post-start transaction effective date or extra eligibility split from DTP*303 when DTP*303 equals the eligibility start date, no unsupported maintenance-date usage is observed for this boundary condition, and no error-driven MELC record is created for the processed member."

scenarios.title: Multiple inbound dates use the first date and preserve backward-compatible date population behavior
gaps: Status field contains "Edge" for id "TC_TS006_003", but no step in Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example Test Step Expected Result: "The loaded transaction effective date reflects 2024-09-01 and no row reflects 2024-10-01 as the selected transaction effective date for this execution, confirming the first assessment date was used while later assessment values were not selected."
